meta.name: content-style-calibration-loop
meta.description: Use when a user edits or criticizes generated copy and you need to extract durable writing-style rules instead of merely remembering surface words.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从编辑反馈中提炼写作风格规则
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常修改AI生成文案，希望固化个人风格。
copy.tagline_en: Extract durable writing rules from editing feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often edit AI-generated copy and want to lock in your style.

howto.what: 当你修改或批评它生成的文案时，它会分析你的改动，提取出你偏好的写作风格规则（如语气、视角、节奏等），而不是简单记住你用的词。下次写作时会按这些规则调整。
howto.when: 当你手动修改它写的文案，或说“不像我”、“太AI”、“没网感”等批评时触发。

say.text: 这段文案太正经了，改成有网感的版本。
say.note: 它会分析你的修改，提取风格规则。

say.text: 记住我改的风格，下次写小红书文案时用。
say.note: 它会将规则沉淀到技能或记忆中。

howto.what_en: When you edit or criticize its generated copy, it analyzes your changes to extract durable writing-style rules (e.g., tone, viewpoint, rhythm) rather than just memorizing words. It applies these rules in future writing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you manually edit its draft or say criticisms like 'not like me', 'too AI', 'no internet vibe'.

say_en.text: This copy is too formal. Rewrite it with an internet-native vibe.
say_en.note: It will analyze your edit and extract style rules.

say_en.text: Remember my style edits and use them for future Xiaohongshu posts.
say_en.note: It will save the rules to skill or memory.
